claims: Jaskirat Singh Rangi is a fictional character.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is portrayed by Ranveer Singh in the 2026 Aditya Dhar-directed spy thriller film Dhurandhar: The Revenge.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is a former Indian Army soldier.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is a "ghost" operative.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is recruited from death row.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi infiltrates the Karachi underworld under the alias Hamza Ali Mazari to battle terrorism.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi was initially a soldier from the Punjab Regiment.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi becomes a vigilante after a personal family tragedy involving local corruption.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi's becoming a vigilante leads to his imprisonment.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi is subsequently recruited by Intelligence Bureau (IB) Chief Ajay Sanyal.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi operates in Pakistan under the name Hamza Ali Mazari.
Jaskirat Singh Rangi infiltrates criminal networks to destroy them from within.
The Revenge (2026) is a spy thriller following the first part.
